notification27: Open Kachingz once after installing or updating, so Shortcuts can see its Log Transaction action.
Open Shortcuts. Tap ‹ until you reach Library, then tap Automation and the + button.
If you see "Describe a shortcut", tap Edit. In the search sheet, tap Automation. Under Apps, choose Notification ("When I receive a notification from…").
Tap App and choose Wallet. Leave Automation switched on.
Search for "Log Transaction" and tap the Kachingz action.
Tap Amount › Select Variable › Notification. Tap the blue Notification tag and choose Body: that's the price.
Tap Merchant › Select Variable › Notification, tap the tag, and choose Subtitle: that's the shop.
Tap Card Name › Select Variable › Notification, tap the tag, and choose Title: that's your bank, which Kachingz matches to the card you saved.
Tap ‹ to save. Your next purchase logs itself.
walletTap27: Open Kachingz once after installing or updating, so Shortcuts can see its Log Transaction action.
Open Shortcuts. Tap ‹ until you reach Library, then tap Automation and the + button.

If you see "Describe a shortcut", tap Edit. In the search sheet, tap Automation. Under Apps, choose Wallet ("When I tap a Wallet Card or Pass"). Leave Any Card, Any Category and Any Merchant as they are.
Search for "Log Transaction" and tap the Kachingz action.
Tap Amount › Select Variable › Transaction. Tap the blue Transaction tag and choose Amount.
Tap Merchant › Select Variable › Transaction, tap the tag, and choose Merchant.
Tap Card Name › Select Variable › Transaction, tap the tag, and choose Card or Pass.
Tap ‹ to save. Your next Apple Pay purchase logs itself.
walletTap26: Open Kachingz once after installing or updating, so Shortcuts can see its Log Transaction action.
Open Shortcuts, tap the Automation tab, then New Automation (or + at the top if you already have one).
Choose Wallet. Leave every card and category selected, choose Run Immediately, and tap Next.
Tap New Blank Automation, then search for "Log Transaction" and tap the Kachingz action.
Tap Amount › Shortcut Input, tap Shortcut Input again, and choose Amount.
Tap Merchant › Shortcut Input, tap it again, and choose Merchant.
Tap Card Name › Shortcut Input, tap it again, and choose Card or Pass.
Tap Done. Your next Apple Pay purchase logs itself.
